text.en:
The article specifically listed hereunder as classified under Section 104 of Republic Act No. 1937 shall
pay the following rate of import duty:
Tariff Heading Number
Description of Articles
Rate of Duty
28.54
Hydrogen peroxide (including solid hydrogen peroxide)

After the expiration of thirty (30) days from the issuance of this Order, the above-described article
entered or withdrawn from warehouse, in the Philippines, for consumption shall be subject to the rate of
import duty herein prescribed.

Any unwarranted increase in the prices of local products benefited by this tariff change may be
sufficient ground for the revocation of such tariff change.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
